# Audio Authority & Playback Policy Requirements Quality Checklist: Abrir Arquivo Pelo Título

**Purpose**: Validate the requirements governing Rust playback authority, auto-play gating, bookmark resume policies (FR-009), and cancellation isolation
**Created**: 2026-11-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Playback Authority & State Machine Invariants

- [x] CHK001 - Does the spec uphold the constitutional principle that Rust remains the sole playback authority for synthesis, buffering, and transport transitions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK002 - Is "immediate audio start" quantified with a concrete latency threshold (< 1.0 second from SAF return)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK003 - Are the preconditions for auto-playing without prompt (fresh document without paused bookmark) explicitly specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]

## Resume Offer & Session Continuity (FR-009)

- [x] CHK004 - Does the spec define the exact resume offer form (`offerDialog` with "Continuar" vs "Do início") when a previously paused document is re-opened? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK005 - Is the timeout window (3.0 seconds auto-resume) for the offer dialog specified in accordance with `contracts/resume.md`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK006 - Is the silent auto-recovery behavior for crash/unexpected-kill documents distinguished from deliberate pauses? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 2]

## Cancellation & Active Transport Isolation

- [x] CHK007 - Is it explicitly documented that canceling or backing out of the system picker causes zero side effects to currently playing audio? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK008 - Does the spec require the outgoing document's playback position to be flushed durably to disk before switching to a new document? [Completeness, Gap]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
